designNotes: Option list lifecycle (state transition): active -> deactivated; new option -> active.
Old records keep a deactivated option (BR-102).

cases.title: A consulting step result is chosen from a drop-down

steps.action: Open a lead's consulting checklist and set a step result
steps.expected: The result field is a drop-down with the configured options; free text cannot be typed into it

cases.title: An option added by Admin appears at once

steps.action: As Admin, add the option "QA mới" to the consulting step result list
steps.expected: The list shows "QA mới" as active

steps.action: Reload a lead's checklist as Consulting

cases.title: A deactivated option disappears from new choices but stays on old records

steps.action: Record a step result "QA mới" on a lead
Open the drop-down on another lead, then reopen the first lead
steps.expected: The drop-down no longer offers "QA mới"; the first lead still shows "QA mới" unchanged

testConditions: Active -> deactivated; old record keeps it
